summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release (Release Number CB22-156) dated September 20, 2022, reporting monthly new residential construction statistics for August 2022. Relevant to the task: It supplies the initial national-level, seasonally adjusted annual rate (SAAR) data for Total Building Permits, Housing Starts, and Housing Completions required to evaluate the task's condition. For August 2022, it lists Permits at 1,517,000, Starts at 1,575,000, and Completions at 1,342,000. This document covers the first month of the task's specified period (August 2022), but the data is marked preliminary and subject to revision by subsequent reports in the collection, which would prevail under the task's conflict resolution rule. It does not contain data for September 2022 through May 2025.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD joint press release on new residential construction for September 2022, released October 19, 2022. Relevant to the task: It provides seasonally adjusted annual rate (SAAR) data for total national building permits, housing starts, and housing completions for August and September 2022, covering the start of the required 2022/08–2025/05 window. For September 2022, the data shows Permits at 1,564,000, Starts at 1,439,000, and Completions at 1,427,000, satisfying the condition (Permits > Starts > Completions). For August 2022, Permits were 1,542,000 and Starts were 1,566,000, failing the first condition. As an early release in the collection, these figures for August and September 2022 may be superseded by more recent reports according to the task's precedence rule for conflicting values.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release (CB22-191) reporting monthly new residential construction statistics for October 2022, released November 17, 2022. Relevant to the task: It provides seasonally adjusted annual rate (SAAR) data for total national building permits, housing starts, and housing completions. Tables 1a, 3a, and 5a contain monthly figures from August through October 2022. Specific values for October 2022 (preliminary) are 1,526,000 permits, 1,425,000 starts, and 1,339,000 completions; revised estimates for August are 1,542,000 permits, 1,508,000 starts, and 1,352,000 completions; revised estimates for September are 1,564,000 permits, 1,488,000 starts, and 1,431,000 completions. This document contributes data for the August–October 2022 segment of the requested 2022/08–2025/05 window. As the latest report for October 2022, its values serve as the current authority for that month, though August and September figures may be superseded by subsequent releases in the collection. It also notes a methodology change for releases beginning in January 2023.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release (CB22-210) titled "Monthly New Residential Construction, November 2022," issued December 20, 2022. It provides national seasonally adjusted annual rates (SAAR) for total building permits, housing starts, and housing completions. The tables (1a, 3a, 5a) include monthly data from August through November 2022, covering the initial segment of the task's 2022/08–2025/05 timeframe. In this report, August 2022 (Permits: 1,542,000; Starts: 1,508,000; Completions: 1,352,000), September 2022, and October 2022 meet the condition (Permits > Starts > Completions), whereas November 2022 (Permits: 1,342,000; Starts: 1,427,000; Completions: 1,490,000) does not. As the release for November 2022, it supplies the primary data for that period within the collection, though its historical figures are subject to potential revision by later monthly reports per the task's precedence rule.
